commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+4' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) blows a huge chance! The ball rebounded out to the edge of the box and he misdirects his shot well wide of the right post.
90+2' Leganes quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
90+2' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
90+1' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) trips an opposition player and Victor Garcia signals a foul.
90' 4 additional min. will be played.
88' Vicente Moreno has decided to make a change. Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna) replaces Ruben Garcia.
88' Ante Budimir will be replaced by Raul Garcia (Osasuna).
87' 1 - 1 Dani Raba (Leganes) easily converts the penalty kick as he sends the ball straight into the top right corner, ricocheting in off the post. Sergio Herrera was helpless.
87' Dani Raba (Leganes) is going to take the penalty!

86' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul. A penalty is awarded to Leganes! Abel Bretones (Osasuna) picks up a yellow card.
86' Leganes failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
86' Juan Cruz (Leganes) strikes a powerful volley towards goal, but one of the defenders blocks his attempt. Leganes force a corner. They send men into the box.

85' Dani Raba (Leganes) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
84' Victor Garcia blows his whistle after Moi Gomez (Osasuna) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Leganes are awarded a free kick from a dangerous position.
83' A substitution has been made. Javi Hernandez is replaced by Yan Diomande (Leganes).
82' Juan Cruz (Leganes) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
81' Half-chance! Yvan Neyou (Leganes) plays a pass into the box, but Sergio Herrera reacts well to snuff out the attack.
80' Victor Garcia blows his whistle and it's Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
78' What a miskick by Seydouba Cisse (Leganes). He smashes a volley from long distance that goes into the stands.
78' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
78' Leganes force their opponents to concede a corner.
77' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) sends a rebound goalwards towards the middle of the target, but the goalkeeper is there to stop it.
77' Here is a change. Jon Moncayola is going off and Vicente Moreno gives the last tactical orders to Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna).
77' Today's match ends for Aimar Oroz who will be replaced by Moi Gomez (Osasuna).
76' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His effort towards the right post is saved by Sergio Herrera.
74' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Leganes for a penalty. Play continues.
73' Flag goes up against Valentin Rosier (Leganes) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.

72' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier. Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Victor Garcia blows his whistle for a foul.
70' The substitution has been made. Munir El Haddadi (Leganes) has replaced Diego Garcia.
70' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) watches the ball all the way and connects well with a volley on the edge of the box, but sends the effort miles over the bar.
69' Dani Raba (Leganes) makes a strong challenge and Victor Garcia blows for a foul.
68' Wasted opportunity! Javi Hernandez (Leganes) picked up a pass and had lots of options, but instead decided to shoot from distance and it went high over the bar.
68' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Victor Garcia who sees an offensive foul.
66' Renato Tapia (Leganes) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. Osasuna are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
65' Seydouba Cisse (Leganes) is penalised for holding. Victor Garcia signals a set piece.
64' Javi Hernandez (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
62' Dani Raba (Leganes) attempts to discuss the decision with Victor Garcia, but he soon realises that it's not the right thing to do as he sees the yellow.
61' Valentin Rosier (Leganes) receives a yellow card for infringement.
61' Diego Garcia (Leganes) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
60' Substitution. Miguel de la Fuente (Leganes) in, Matija Nastasic out.
59' Diego Garcia (Leganes) attempts to score with a first-time shot from the edge of the box. His low effort towards the middle of the goal is saved by Sergio Herrera.
58' The resulting set piece from Osasuna is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
58' Wow, what an escape. Ante Budimir (Osasuna) has an effort from inside the box but it's brilliantly blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Osasuna.

57' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Marko Dmitrovic anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going into the left side of the target.
57' Juan Cruz (Leganes) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Osasuna.
55' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) is literally asking for a yellow card with his behaviour. The referee agrees and books him.
54' Juan Cruz (Leganes) commits a foul after making a slide tackle on his opponent.
53' Juan Cruz (Leganes) picks up a long through ball, but Sergio Herrera deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
49' 0 - 1 Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) meets the corner and displays his eye for goal as he coolly plants a header from close range into the right side of the goal. The score is 0:1.
49' Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
49' Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
48' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) lifts the ball into the box from the corner, but one of the defending players gets there first to head it clear.
47' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
47' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Osasuna.
46' Referee Victor Garcia blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+2' The end of the first half.

45+2' Sergio Gonzalez Poirrier (Leganes) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His accurate header would have probably ended up inside the right post, but Sergio Herrera pulls off a decent save to thwart him.
45+1' The expression of the referee Victor Garcia is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) is shown a yellow card.
45' There will be a minimum of 1 min. of added time.
45' An accurate cross picks out Lucas Torro (Osasuna) in the centre of the box, but his header floats harmlessly high over the bar.
45' The ball goes out of play and Osasuna have been awarded a corner kick.
45' Abel Bretones (Osasuna) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
43' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) threw away a promising scoring opportunity. He received a fine cross inside the 6-yard box, but his shot missed the target close to the right post.
41' The goal by Osasuna is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
40' The Osasuna players halt their celebrations as referee Victor Garcia makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.

39' It's in! Ruben Garcia spots his teammate in a good position on the edge of the box and provides him with a nice pass. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) doesn't think twice and rifles a first-time shot into the bottom right corner. The score is now 0:0.
39' Osasuna take a short corner kick.
39' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players. The referee blows his whistle, Osasuna are awarded a corner kick.
38' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Osasuna.
38' Leganes enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
36' Flavien Boyomo (Osasuna) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Dani Raba (Leganes) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Victor Garcia stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
33' Wonderful pass from Javi Hernandez (Leganes) for Diego Garcia, but they can't profit from it as Sergio Herrera comes off his line to collect.
33' Marko Dmitrovic (Leganes) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
32' Yvan Neyou (Leganes) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! A free kick is awarded to Osasuna.
30' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) came close to scoring. He connected with a pass inside the box and perhaps should have done better than direct his shot straight at Marko Dmitrovic.
27' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
26' Lucas Torro (Osasuna) brings an opponent down and Victor Garcia interrupts the game.
24' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Leganes, is overhit and the ball goes out of play.
23' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Aimar Oroz (Osasuna). Free kick. Leganes will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
22' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) takes the corner, but the opposition's defence is ready and clears the ball to safety.

22' A neat pass is well received by Jon Moncayola (Osasuna), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the roof of the net, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.
21' Good movement by Juan Cruz (Leganes), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
20' Chance! Ante Budimir (Osasuna) was in a good position inside the box, but he couldn't connect with the pass as it was overhit.
18' Renato Tapia (Leganes) picks up a sweet pass and fires one in from distance towards the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera is alert and makes a decent save.
17' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Marko Dmitrovic, who smothers the ball.
14' Renato Tapia (Leganes) changes the direction of the ball using his hand, but he is angry when the referee gives a foul against him.
13' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Javi Hernandez (Leganes).

11' Juan Cruz (Leganes) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Sergio Herrera!
10' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Victor Garcia blows his whistle for an infringement.
8' Jesus Areso (Osasuna) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
6' Dani Raba (Leganes) shows too much aggression during an attacking move and ends up fouling his opponent.

6' Jorge Herrando (Osasuna) attempts to score as he rises near the penalty spot and heads the ball to the bottom right corner of the goal. Marko Dmitrovic displays brilliant reflexes and pulls off a comfortable save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
6' It will be a corner kick for Osasuna.

5' Ruben Garcia (Osasuna) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. Corner kick. Osasuna will have an opportunity.
4' Juan Cruz (Leganes) is flagged for offside.
4' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) picks up a long through ball, but Marko Dmitrovic deserves praise for a brilliant reaction and interception.
3' The ball is behind the touchline and Osasuna will take a throw-in.
2' Leganes work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Leganes will have the kick-off.
Victor Garcia got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
Show lineups In the details of this match, you can glance at the lineups while the game is about to begin.
